audit.whatIsWrong: Rated TRICKY 7/10 on a 50.93% win rate over 214 games, and the level chart gives Cassiopeia 6 of 7 stages while the full layer already reads Skill at rows 4, 5 and 6 — the two layers disagreed with each other.
audit.why: 50.93% is a dead-even matchup. Cassiopeia genuinely owns levels 1-5 (Noxious Blast 850 vs your Q's 750, Miasma grounds Astral Flight), but Falling Star at 6 and Rod of Ages after it level it out, and the full build out-ranges her 700 Twin Fang.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 5/10; chart Cassiopeia x4 / Skill / Skill / Aurelion Sol, matched on both layers.
sources: brief kits: ownerKit Q 750, enemyKit Q 850 / E 700

audit.whatIsWrong: Content spikes and the late text build Shadowflame/Stormsurge; the full layer's itemization builds Rod of Ages, Archangel's, Liandry's, Rabadon's.
audit.why: One page, two different builds. The full layer report[8] is the stated build, so the content spikes were realigned to it.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text, late and breakdown.spikes rewritten around Rod of Ages and Archangel's; the level-6 spike now names the 120s-vs-120s ultimate race.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions were never stated. (a) Miasma grounds, and Astral Flight is a movement ability — inside the cloud your W does not fire at all. (b) Petrifying Gaze only STUNS enemies facing her; enemies with their back turned are merely slowed.
audit.why: enemyKit W: 'Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.' enemyKit R: 'stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.' The page said only 'dashes and leaps are disabled', which reads as if Aurelion Sol were unaffected — he is the champion most affected, because W is his only escape.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dontsFull[2].d, spikes[1].text, mid and whys[4] now state both.
sources: ownerKit W text — Astral Flight is a flight/movement ability

audit.whatIsWrong: The missingInteractions needs-antiheal rule was not reflected in lane advice — only report[8] mentioned anti-heal in passing.
audit.why: Twin Fang is a 0.75s cooldown that heals Cassiopeia for a percentage of damage dealt. Without Grievous Wounds, chip trades feed her.
audit.corrected: ahead, breakdown.feeding and dontsFull[0].d now make Grievous Wounds the condition on fighting her at all.
sources: enemyKit E: heal flag and text

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Voice of Light' used as an Aurelion Sol ability in spikes[3] and content late.
audit.why: Not in the kit. The abilities are Breath of Light (Q), Astral Flight (W), the black hole (E), Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R).
audit.corrected: Replaced with Breath of Light and The Skies Descend.

audit.whatIsWrong: content early said 'Stay mobile with E'; content mid said 'before Astral Flight finishes charging'.
audit.why: E is a stationary black hole, not mobility. Astral Flight does not charge — it is a 22s-at-rank-1 flight, and Miasma disables it entirely.
